Q1. What exact part of this repository should change? Include the workflow/job/file/path in your answer.

C. One docs/log-output surface
D. Multiple related areas; I will list each one explicitly
Q2. How should we interpret "better" for that target?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug/regression with the smallest safe change (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability/performance without changing intended behavior
C. Improve wording/docs/log readability only
D. Add or change behavior
Q3. What concrete reference should we use as the acceptance target? Include the URL/path/text/example in your answer.
Choices:
A. A failing workflow run URL, error message, or log snippet (RECOMMENDED)
B. A current-vs-desired behavior example (RECOMMENDED)
C. A specific issue/PR/run/file that shows the result to match
D. A precise one-sentence acceptance criterion I will write
